annotations.title: What the site does not do

description: The site’s limits, to state before acting for a person: it takes no bookings, gives no medical advice, holds no medical records, does not rank practitioners and sets no prices of its own; and ILIT is not FDA-approved, so in the US it is given off-label. Takes no input.
